original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚首都区工会就NLC罢工出现分裂：TUC退出，NULGE加入
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦首都区（FCT）的工会组织因尼日利亚劳工大会（NLC）FCT理事会宣布的无限期罢工而出现严重分裂。贸易工会大会（TUC）以未获协商为由指示成员无视罢工、正常上班，而尼日利亚地方政府雇员工会（NULGE）则指示其成员加入罢工。此次罢工源于FCTA与尼日利亚教师工会（NUT）之间未解决的争端。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚劳工大会（NLC）FCT理事会宣布无限期罢工
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The NLC had on Wednesday directed workers in the Federal Capital Territory Administration (FCTA), including those in the private sector, to begin an indefinite strike on Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: 贸易工会大会（TUC）指示成员无视罢工并正常上班
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Trade Union Congress (TUC) had instructed its members to ignore the strike and report for work

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚地方政府雇员工会（NULGE）指示成员加入罢工
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Nigeria Union of Local Government Employees (NULGE) threw its full weight behind the action.

key_facts.fact: 罢工源于FCTA与尼日利亚教师工会（NUT）之间未解决的争端
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The strike was over unresolved disputes between the FCTA and the Nigeria Union of Teachers (NUT).

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
